title: Core upgrade input (v1 and categorized v2)

$schema.description: Schema used by editors to validate this operator input.

apiVersion.description: Input format version; v2 supports named rule and snapshot categories.

name.description: Deployment identifier used in generated run artifacts and credential recipes.
Configured live Hardhat network for reads, deployments and governance execution.

chainId.description: Expected chain ID for every contract address and execution check.

fork.description: Matching fork network for optional rehearsal of the same deployment.

network.description: Chain used for the complete workflow; the fork is only for an optional rehearsal.

ref.description: Intended target Core Solidity release. Its contracts tree must match the reviewed upgrade source.

baselineRef.description: Git provenance for the deployed Core baseline; this does not by itself prove deployed bytecode parity.

release.description: Core Solidity source references; these do not select releases for peripheral contracts.

deployer.description: Keystore wallet paying to deploy new Core facets and libraries.

rpc.description: Archive-capable RPC keystore reference for chain reads and transaction submission.

explorer.description: Explorer API key keystore reference for publishing new Core facets and libraries.

credentials.description: Keystore references used by the workflow; the Core governance signer is configured separately.

confirmations.description: Required confirmation count for deployments and governance receipts.

txTimeoutSeconds.description: Transaction receipt wait timeout in seconds; a timeout triggers recovery, not a new transaction intent.

slowNoticeSeconds.description: Seconds before a slow transaction notice; must be shorter than the receipt timeout.

verify.description: Require explorer publication of new Core facets and libraries after verified service restoration.

logLevel.description: Workflow logging level supported by the live deployment runtime.

execution.description: Workflow-wide transaction waiting, logging and explorer publication settings.

kind.description: Whether the Core owner is a Safe or an EOA.

owner.description: Expected owner of target.core; authorizes the Core pause, cut and restoration actions.

signerMode.description: Delivery method for Core owner actions, independent of the deployment wallet.

signerKey.description: Governance keystore entry name when the Core signer mode is hardhat-keystore.

ledgerDerivation.description: Ledger derivation family when signing Core owner actions with Ledger.

accountLayerOwner.description: Expected existing Account Layer owner; checked independently of the Core owner.

governance.description: Core ownership and governance signing, plus the expected owner of the existing Account Layer.

core.description: Core diamond receiving the facet cut, role grants, funding repairs and maintenance pause actions.

collateral.description: Existing collateral token checked against Core and Gasless wiring.

accountLayer.description: Existing Account Layer; its owner, selectors and wiring are checked.

instantLayer.description: Existing Instant Layer; Core/Account Layer pointers, context state and operator wiring are checked.

signatureVerifier.description: Existing Muon Signature Verifier whose runtime, configuration and administrative membership are checked.

symbolManager.description: Existing Symbol Manager whose runtime and Core role identity are checked; no Symbol Manager settings are updated.

gaslessLayer.description: Existing Gasless Layer checked for Core, collateral, Account/Instant Layer and treasury wiring.

liquidator.description: Existing Liquidator proxy; runtime, implementation and Core liquidation role are checked.

gaslessReceiver.description: Expected existing Gasless treasury receiver account; not an execution layer.

partyB.description: Existing solver PartyB contract; Core pointer, implementation and Instant Layer permissions are checked.

multicall.description: Contract used to batch block-pinned read calls during snapshot collection.

target.description: Only core is upgraded. Other entries identify existing dependencies, collateral, the treasury receiver and read infrastructure.

requiredFunctions.description: Muon function names requiring fresh routed positive and negative restoration canaries.

additionalVerifierRoles.description: Additional Signature Verifier role hashes whose administrative membership is inventoried and preserved.

maxRoleMembers.description: Legacy maximum members per inventoried Signature Verifier role; prefer limits.signatureVerifierSnapshot.maxRoleMembers.

maxSigners.description: Legacy maximum entries in each verifier public-key and gateway-signer list; prefer limits.signatureVerifierSnapshot.maxSigners.

muon.description: Preservation and restoration-readiness policy for Core Muon routes and the existing Signature Verifier; no verifier roles are granted.

limits.description: Off-chain snapshot scan bounds; reaching a larger inventory stops the workflow without accepting partial evidence.

storage.description: Core storage-layout compatibility rules, evaluated through Core getters.

repairAggregateFunding.description: Legacy Core aggregate-funding reconciliation rule; v2 uses funding.aggregate.repair.

allowedRemovedSelectors.description: Legacy Core selector-removal allowlist; v2 uses selectors.core.allowedRemovals.

roleGrants.description: Persistent grants on Core; the contract category identifies the role store and each holder identifies the recipient.

kind.description: Inventory item type; does not authorize upgrades or role grants.

address.description: Context address whose runtime hash is recorded; contract entries must have code.

kind.description: Inventory item type; does not authorize upgrades or role grants.

url.description: Context subgraph endpoint; this workflow does not query or validate its indexed contents.

inventory.description: Contextual contracts, accounts and subgraphs outside the Core cut. Address runtime hashes are recorded; subgraph URLs are not queried automatically.

funding.description: Core accounting migration policy; does not configure solver or layer fees.

maxQuotes.description: Legacy maximum historical Core quote IDs to scan, including closed quotes.

maxSymbols.description: Legacy maximum registered Core symbols to scan; not a Symbol Manager capacity setting.

maxHistoricalQuotes.description: Maximum complete Core quote-history scan, from quote ID 1 through the last assigned ID.

maxRegisteredSymbols.description: Maximum symbols read from Core.getSymbols; does not change Symbol Manager listing limits.

coreSnapshot.description: Bounds for reading Core quote history and its symbol registry.

maxRoleMembers.description: Maximum members per inventoried verifier role. When omitted, uses legacy muon.maxRoleMembers or defaults to 100.

maxSigners.description: Maximum entries separately in verifier public-key and gateway-signer lists. When omitted, uses legacy muon.maxSigners or defaults to 100.

signatureVerifierSnapshot.description: Bounds for enumerating existing Muon Signature Verifier administrative roles and signer lists.

holder.description: Literal recipient address for a Core role grant.

holderRef.description: Named recipient resolved from the input; it identifies the holder, not the contract storing the role.

role.description: Core role name hashed with keccak256 for Core.grantRole(holder, role).

core.description: Roles stored on target.core; exactly one holder or holderRef is required per grant.

legacyAdjustmentWords.description: Required zero ABI words returned by the legacy Core getter; one word is 32 bytes, not a physical storage slot.

upgradedAdjustmentWords.description: Required zero ABI words returned by the upgraded Core getter.

requireEmptyAdjustments.description: Every scanned symbol adjustment must be empty; nonzero retained state blocks this workflow.

symbolAdjustment.description: Compatibility of Core.getSymbolAdjustment before and after the facet cut.

repair.description: Require checked repair of mismatched Core aggregate funding and restoration of the owner migration role.

allowedRemovals.description: Reviewed Core selectors that may be removed by the facet cut; other removals stop planning.

core.description: Selector policy for the Core diamond at target.core.
